meta.mode: RGB, no metadata (AI-generated render; text and spacing have small irregularities)
meta.units: reference-image pixels; bbox = {x,y,w,h} with x,y = top-left inclusive pixel
meta.design_scale: 1 image px = 1 CSS px. Body text measures 16px, labels 12-14px, so the render is a 1:1 desktop frame (~1672x941 viewport). For a 1920 wide screen scale x1.148, for 1440 scale x0.861 (or keep px and let the fluid columns absorb width).
meta.method: PIL/numpy/scipy/OpenCV pixel analysis: luminance-peak border tracing, diagonal corner-radius fits, grey-opening background subtraction + connected components for text/icon boxes, OpenCV thinning for icon stroke widths, polar unwrap + circle fits for the orb, Playwright-Chromium rendering of 28 sans + 15 mono candidate fonts scored by word-level NCC.
